title: Transition from Preface to Episode One

blocks.text: This damaged page survives chiefly as a hinge between the prefatory defense and Episode 1 rather than as a fully legible narrative unit.
Its position between the final claims about Sikh sovereignty and the invocation pages shows that the book is moving from justification into formal commencement.
The transition gathers the energy of the prologue and prepares the reader for the ceremonial opening of Sri Gur Panth Prakash.

rawBlocks.text: Direct OCR extraction for this source page was empty in the native corpus. The readable transition is grounded in the adjacent retained source window: page 44 closes the prefatory defense of Khalsa sovereignty, and page 46 opens the Sri Gur Panth Prakash invocation before Episode 1.
